response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component TOX21_AChE_Colorimetric_Antagonist was normalized to the positive control, BW284C51, and fit as percent of the positive control in the positive direction. Data are used in conjuction with the fluorescent version of this assay, TOX21_AChE_Fluor_Antagonist, to identify inhibitors of acetylcholinesterase.
response.assayComponentDesc: TOX21_AChE_Colorimetric_Antagonist is an assay readout measuring inhibition of human recombinant acetylcholinesterase activity in a biochemical format using a colorimetric substrate.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: The assay uses 5, 5-dithiobis-(2-nitrobenzoic acid) (DTNB) to quantify the thiocholine produced from the hydrolysis of acetylthiocholine by AChE from the SH-SY5Y cells. AChE hydrolyses the acetylthiocholine to produce thiocholine that in turn reduces the DTNB, producing 5-thio-2-nitrobenzoic acid (TNB) which absorbs at 405 nm.
response.assayDesc: TOX21_AChE_Colorimetric_Antagonist is a cell-based, single-readout assay that uses SH-SY5Y, a human bone marrow cell line, with measurements taken at 24 hours after chemical dosing in a 1536-well plate. See tox21-ache-p3.
response.assaySourceLongName: Toxicology in the 21st Century federal research collaboration
response.assaySourceDesc: The Toxicology in the 21st Century (Tox21) program aims to develop better toxicity assessment methods to quickly and efficiently test whether certain chemical compounds have the potential to disrupt processes in the human body that may lead to negative health effects. The Tox21 consortium is a federal collaboration between EPA, the National Toxicology Program (NTP) headquartered at the National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences (NIEHS), the National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences (NCATS) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The NIH Chemical Genomics Center (NCGC) is the primary screening facility running ultra high-throughput screening assays across a large interagency-developed chemical library, often referred to as the Tox21 10K Library.
